meta.note: Virginia's weekly sales reported by USDA are state graded sales, where state graders grade the cattle and they sell in groups of similar grade and weight, so these prices come from graded sales. Virginia also holds board sales and other graded sales which aren't in these prices. The latest special sales are listed under [About this week's sales].
